summary: Verified fix for header login link: clicking data-testid=header-account-link when logged out now navigates away to Google/auth.emergentagent.com sign-in flow instead of silently staying on the same page. Link is visible and unobstructed on both desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px) viewports. No app-origin console errors on home page load.

checks.criterion: Clicking header login link must navigate away to Google's OAuth sign-in (not stay on same page)
checks.name: header-login-navigates-to-google
checks.evidence: Clicked data-testid=header-account-link on desktop (1440x900); page.waitForURL matched /accounts.google.com|auth.emergentagent.com/ within 15s. Final page.url() was on the auth/google domain, confirming real navigation away from the app (not a same-page no-op).

checks.criterion: Header login link visible and clickable on both desktop and mobile viewports
checks.name: header-login-visible-both-viewports
checks.evidence: data-testid=header-account-link visible with valid boundingBox() at 1440x900 and 390x844. document.elementFromPoint() at the mobile link's center resolved to the link itself (or a descendant), confirming no overlay obscures it.

checks.criterion: No console errors or failed same-origin API requests on home page load
checks.name: home-page-no-app-console-errors
checks.evidence: Collected all console 'error' and pageerror events on '/' load; filtered out third-party auth.emergentagent.com/accounts.google.com/ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED noise. Zero app-origin errors remained.

checks.criterion: Logged-in user sees 'मेरा खाता' and clicking navigates to /account, not Google
checks.evidence: Briefing explicitly states this requires a real Google OAuth session/cookie fixture which is not available; no test_credentials.md or session fixture was provided for a logged-in state. Marked unverifiable in this run per briefing's own guidance (spec_deviations).

action_items.detail: No logged-in session fixture/credentials available to verify the 'मेरा खाता' / /account navigation branch of the header link for authenticated users. Briefing pre-acknowledged this as unverifiable without real Google OAuth.

Ran full backend suite (cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q): 18 failed, 10 passed in tests/test_tscheck_content_coverage.py and tests/test_tscheck_paid_access_control.py (all failing with 401 'पहले Google से लॉगिन करें' on paths expected to succeed with fixture cookies, and content-coverage assertions). These failures are UNRELATED to the header-login-link fix under test (no backend code was touched in this session; git log shows no backend/tests changes since MVP commit). Not part of this iteration's acceptance_matrix. Flagging for main agent awareness only, not blocking this iteration's retest_needed.

notes: The 4th matrix criterion (logged-in state) is a code/DOM-logic-only inspection per the briefing since no real OAuth session is available; verified via source review of /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx line 66: Link to={user ? "/account" : "#"} with onClick preventDefault + window.location.assign(googleLoginUrl()) only when logged out — matches expected spec description. All UI-facing, testable criteria (1, 2, 4-partial) passed via browser checks.
